# Contract hooks JavaScript API

Every contract an app's JS may touch: a hook for each of its operations (`on<Contract><Operation>`, which may change the call's input or refuse it), `onContracts` to provide contracts from `pb_hooks`, and the contracts' types. See [Contracts](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts); their Go side is in the [Go API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go).

## Functions

### onContracts()

```ts
onContracts(handler: (e: contracts.DeclareEvent) => void): void
```

Declares and provides the app's contracts, once, after pb_hooks load.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: contracts.DeclareEvent) => void` |  |

### onBulkmailCount()

```ts
onBulkmailCount(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.bulkmail.v1.CountInput>) => void): void
```

Count says how many recipients an audience reaches, how many of them are suppressed, and a few sample addresses.

Runs on every count call to bulkmail/v1, from any surface (HTTP, Go, MCP, the CLI): change e.input, or throw to
refuse.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.bulkmail.v1.CountInput>) => void` |  |

### onLlmChatSend()

```ts
onLlmChatSend(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.chat.v1.SendInput>) => void): void
```

Send asks the chat a question: the provider sends the system text, the chat's summary, its recent messages and
the question (with Context after it) to llm.text/v1, saves both turns, and folds older messages into the summary
when it's due.

Runs on every send call to llm.chat/v1, from any surface (HTTP, Go, MCP, the CLI): change e.input, or throw to
refuse.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.chat.v1.SendInput>) => void` |  |

### onLlmSearchAdd()

```ts
onLlmSearchAdd(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.AddInput>) => void): void
```

Add puts a file or pasted text in a bucket as its own source (one document), replacing the source of that name.
The same text again costs nothing; changed text embeds only its new chunks. It returns at once; the document is
embedded in the background (its status says how far it got).

Runs on every add call to llm.search/v1, from any surface (HTTP, Go, MCP, the CLI): change e.input, or throw to
refuse.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.AddInput>) => void` |  |

### onLlmSearchUpload()

```ts
onLlmSearchUpload(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.ExtkitRawIn>) => void): void
```

Upload adds a file sent as the request body: ?bucket=<name>&name=<file name>[&replace=<source>]. A .zip is one
source with a document per text file inside it; anything else is a file source.

```ts
onLlmSearchAddURL(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.URLInput>) => void): void
```

### onLlmSearchAddFolder()

```ts
onLlmSearchAddFolder(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.FolderInput>) => void): void
```

AddFolder adds a folder of the app's own files on the server (named by its path, replacing one of that name):
every text file in it, read in the background and read again every few minutes, so changed files are embedded
again and removed ones leave. With URL, each result from it links to the page that file is published at.

Runs on every add_folder call to llm.search/v1, from any surface (HTTP, Go, MCP, the CLI): change e.input, or throw to
refuse.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.FolderInput>) => void` |  |

```ts
onLlmSearchDetectURL(handler: (e: contracts.CallEvent<contracts.llm.search.v1.URLRef>) => void): void
```

DetectURL says how AddURL would read a URL: as a Git repository when its server answers the Git protocol (any

Runs on every detect_u_r_l call to llm.search/v1, from any surface (HTTP, Go, MCP, the CLI): change e.input, or throw to

### contracts.AnyProvider

A JS implementation of a contract with no declarations here: an object with its methods.

### contracts.DeclareEvent

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `provide()` | `(id: Id, impl: Id extends keyof Providers ? Providers[Id] : AnyProvider): void` | Provides a contract from JS: an object with its methods (typed by contracts.Providers for known ids). |
| `require()` | `(...ids: string[]): void` | The app needs this contract: the start fails (dev mode: warns) when nothing provides it. |
| `worksWith()` | `(...ids: string[]): void` | Works with this contract when present (shown in the startup lines). |
| `next()` | `(): void` |  |

| Member | Type | |

| `model` | `string` | "provider/model", required |
| `audio` | `LlmFile` | its Name's extension (story.mp3) or Type tells the provider the format |

### contracts.llm.chat.v1.SendInput

SendInput is a question for a chat and how to ask it.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `system` | `string` | System is the preamble, sent first on every turn (keep it the same for the prompt cache). |
| `window` | `number` | Window is how many recent messages to send (default 12); older ones reach the model through the summary. |
| `summarizeEvery` | `number` | SummarizeEvery folds the messages that left the window into the summary once that many have (default 6). |
| `context` | `string` | Context is text sent after the question (the passages that answer it, say). The chat keeps the question as sent, to send it the same way next turn; history shows the question alone. |
| `schema` | `any` |  |
| `maxTokens` | `number` |  |
| `temperature` | `number \| null` |  |
| `model` | `string` | Model is the text model to answer with ("provider/model", required). |
| `reasoning` | `string` | Reasoning is how much a reasoning model thinks first: "", "off", "low", "medium" or "high". Enrich adds the best passages from the app's search buckets after the question, beside Context (search/v1); |
| `enrich` | `LlmEnrich \| null` | the answer's Passages lists them. |
